prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original Farm Natura Farm Life website chapter illustration, square transparent cutout.
Input image 1 is ONLY the exact visual style and character-design reference: the existing Our Story mango-tree illustration. Create a NEW natural-farming composition, do not duplicate the reference's bench scene.
Primary request: render Farm Life as a companion illustration from the SAME illustrated book and SAME artist as Our Story. Match the reference's two-dimensional Indian folk-art drawing, bold fine navy ink outlines, decorative flat gouache colors, stylized figures, patterned clothes and terracotta surfaces. This is a flat hand-drawn narrative illustration, not a realistically painted scene.
Scene and composition: a compact botanical garden, elegant mango branches rising behind a family actively farming. A woman in a coral-orange sari with teal blouse and tiny cream decorative patterns, with the same charming illustrated face and stylized flowing navy-black hair as the woman in the reference, gently harvesting tomatoes. Beside her a man in a cream kurta with teal decorative edging kneels to tend the soil; draw him in exactly the same simplified folk-art character language. A young child in a sky-blue patterned kurta, visually matching the reference child, plants a seedling with the man. Arrange the figures clearly in the lower-middle. Surround them with graceful, clearly separated tomato vines, a few purple aubergines, okra plants and marigold flowers. A decorated terracotta pot and woven vegetable basket anchor the bottom corners. Use a small stylized warm terracotta soil patch with a few decorative roots and a single earthworm, not a realistic dirt cross-section. One small yellow and navy bird on an upper branch.
Style invariants: draw ALL faces as stylized ink line art, warm flat ochre skin, simple almond eyes, expressive curved brows and simple curved nose and mouth, just like the reference. No realistic facial anatomy, pores, photographic hair, muscle or skin lighting. Long elegant emerald and mint leaves with sharp dark outlines and thin golden leaf veins, as in the reference. A winding coral-orange branch with small leafy decorative patterns and dots. Ornamental textures are tiny drawn dots and patterned strokes, not realistic watercolor shading. Distinct flat color areas, restrained print-grain, very little gradient, no deep modeled shadows. Keep airy openings between plants; favor beautiful curated large leaf silhouettes over a dense realistic thicket.
Color palette precisely follows image 1: deep emerald #07584c, teal-green #247766, pale sage and mint, coral-orange #ec7850, warm golden mango yellow, navy ink, cream and a little powder blue.
Framing: entire composition visible inside the square, about 85-90 percent of canvas, 5 percent clear margin around all outer leaves, asymmetrical rounded organic silhouette. Genuinely transparent background, with transparent gaps between leaves; no background disk because the website supplies it. No text, logo, letters, captions, watermarks, frame, house, roof or architecture. The result should be unmistakably as stylized and ornamental as the supplied Our Story illustration, with absolutely no photorealism, cinematic lighting, 3D forms or realistic painted people.
